formalizedScope: Theorem 1.1 complete right-hand-side statement layer with one-based to zero-based index translation
All directly numbered results in Section 2
Section 3 definitions and propositions through Proposition 3.7, including all Table 1 classification and Table 2 maximality rows
Lemmas 3.9-3.11 and 3.13-3.14 with literal published endpoint models
Lemma 4.2 complete equivalence using the exact square/discriminant tests and deep same-rank completion
Lemma 4.3 complete exceptional N_2^n(Delta) test with both strict defect conclusions and exact nonrepresentation
Lemmas 4.4-4.5 and Theorem 4.1 complete, together with the exact I1E-I3E condition layer and Theorem 4.7 invariant conversion
Remark 5.2 and Lemmas 5.4 and 5.6-5.9, including both literal Lemma 5.9 tests and the exact at-least-one failure conclusion
Abstract O-maximal testing reduction underlying Theorem 1.2
excludedScope: Theorem 1.2 explicit testing list and minimality proof
Remarks 3.8 and 3.12 as explicit correspondence endpoints
Corollary 4.6 and Theorem 4.7 as direct endpoints
Theorem 5.1, Theorem 5.3, Proposition 5.5, Lemmas 5.10-5.11, and all numbered results in Section 6
reviewNotice: Sections 2 and 3 and the complete Theorem 4.1 proof chain are kernel checked. Section 5 is checked through Lemma 5.9. Its clause (ii) excludes simultaneous representation of the two literal tests and therefore gives failure for at least one test; it does not assert separate failure for both. Corollary 4.6, Theorem 4.7, the remaining Section 5 results, Section 6, and both main theorems remain incomplete. Theorem 1.1 is still an unproved proposition target, and the proved maximal-testing theorem is only the abstract core of Theorem 1.2, not its explicit list or minimality assertion.
